cases.name: signed-run
cases.intent: Real signed demo A + committed authority yields RUN with original watchdog history and EMPTY continuity.
asserts: outer OK/RUNTIME; bridge OK valid=7; runtime OK valid=3; selection evidence_mask=1 and verify_result[A]=OK
exact slot A/MSP=BOOT_INITIAL_MSP/reset=A+9 and full authority record equal
configure pointer == runtime pointer == &continuity.watchdog; configs=1 loads=1 ICRs=3 feeds=2 payload_reads=1
feed tuples (verification,epoch,completed) == [(1,1,0),(1,2,BOOT_PAYLOAD_MIN)]; final epoch=3 verification=1 owner=BOOT; evidence=0 not blocked; continuity EMPTY
zero flash erases/programs; every prepublication callback sees byte-identical output sentinel; duplicate CONSUMED/NONE no IO or output changes

cases.name: early-stop
cases.intent: An initial RESC IO error consumes without touching stale continuity, diagnostics, producer, store or output.
asserts: FAILED/EARLY_READ; exactly one raw read; zero producer/store/payload/clear/configure calls
continuity and diagnostic64 bytes unchanged, out unchanged; duplicate no IO

cases.name: producer-stop
cases.intent: Ignored WDT gate stops before runtime with terminal producer quarantine and no recovery IO.
asserts: FAILED/PRODUCER; one RESC read; producer calls=3 writes=1 delays=0 configure=0 runtime=0
FAILED continuity, watchdog blocked/evidence=0; zero reset writes/store/payload; out unchanged; duplicate no IO

cases.name: capture-read-failure
cases.intent: The first runtime capture is new IO and an IO error cannot publish CAPTURE or access clear/store.
asserts: FAILED/RUNTIME; bridge RUNTIME_FAILED valid=3; runtime RESET_FAILED valid=1; reset CAPTURE_FAILED/report.valid=0
raw reads=2; clear writes=0; store/payload/feed=0; one original configure; epoch=1 verification=0 blocked/evidence=0; out unchanged; duplicate no IO

cases.name: capture-fullword-mismatch
cases.intent: A fresh capture differing solely in unsupported bit31 fails before clear/store.
asserts: same exact nested failure tuple as capture-read-failure
early=2 fresh=0x80000002; raw reads=2; clear writes/store/payload/feed=0; out unchanged; duplicate no IO

cases.name: fresh-clear
cases.intent: A later independent RESC clear read may change and preserves all uncaptured/unsupported bits.
asserts: early=capture=0x80000002; later=0xc000001a; exactly 3 reads and one write=0xc0000018
same signed RUN and original-watchdog invariants as signed-run; clear precedes store

cases.name: zero-supported
cases.intent: Matching unsupported-only capture skips clear IO while real selection still succeeds.
asserts: early=capture=0x80000000; exactly 2 raw reads; zero reset writes
same signed RUN and original-watchdog invariants as signed-run

cases.name: clear-faults
cases.intent: Clear read failure and possibly effected write failure stop without store/replay and preserve only CAPTURE evidence.
asserts: two distinct fresh modeled boots: CLEAR_READ_FAILED with reads=3 writes=0; CLEAR_WRITE_FAILED with reads=3 writes=1 last_write=0
both report.valid=CAPTURE; bridge RUNTIME_FAILED valid=3/runtime RESET_FAILED valid=1
store/payload/feeds=0; original configure once epoch=1 verification=0 blocked/evidence=0; out unchanged; duplicate no IO

cases.name: guards
cases.intent: Callback reentry is BUSY and success is terminal CONSUMED without IO or output mutation.
asserts: callback attempts at raw RESC, producer, delay, store, reader and runtime WDT boundaries return BUSY/NONE; >20 witnesses
each attempt preserves IO counters and output sentinel; all signed-run assertions still hold
postreturn CONSUMED/NONE no counter/output changes; no guard escape/reinit

cases.name: structural
cases.intent: Invalid output spans and descriptors reject before IO, permitting correction on the same fresh sequence.
asserts: nine sequential pre-admission probes: null/misaligned/sequence-alias output, zero/overflow Hz, null continuity/reader, output reader-context alias, diagnostic/output alias
each ARGUMENT/NONE; sequence byte-identical and not consumed; no callbacks/output mutations
corrected same object completes real signed RUN; no reinit between rejection and correction

cases.name: signature-reject
cases.intent: A corrupted signed manifest cannot become modeled verifier success or trigger a feed/payload read.
asserts: flip signature byte96; FAILED/RUNTIME bridge RUNTIME_FAILED runtime.valid=3
evidence_mask=1 verify_result[A]=ERROR_SIGNATURE; payload_reads=feeds=0; configure=1 verification=1 epoch=1
blocked/evidence=0; output unchanged; duplicate no IO

cases.name: arm-closure
cases.intent: Official GNU Arm compiles the uninstrumented shared unit and links its real dependency closure, not a whole boot image.
cases.class: ARM compile and final unit-link closure
asserts: fixed absolute GCC path and version15.3; Cortex-M3 Thumb soft-float Os enum32
unit ELF has zero undefined symbols; exactly one T/t symbol for sequence_run, producer_begin_io, runtime_watchdog_run, reset_handler_run, boot_select, boot_verify_manifest, mbedtls_ecdsa_verify
linewise decoder exact (address,mnemonic,operands) selfchecks include 3 operandless NOPs/bx lr and 32-bit mrs
shared object exact mrs register,PRIMASK instruction exists; full map/disassembly retained; no boot 32KiB fit claim
